verdict.rationale: Evidence shows OCI has a 'Select AI Agent Framework' with team-sharing across database schemas, indicating some first-party agent orchestration capability exists — but this is a single release-note mention, not a documented, dedicated agent runtime/orchestration service with architecture, APIs, or deployment guides comparable to a full 'AI agent home'. Missing for 10: dedicated agent runtime service docs, agent deployment/hosting details, tool/orchestration APIs, lifecycle management guidance, and independent corroboration of production use.
